test_GTestFilterUnitTest: test the GTestFilterUnitTest class to verify Google Test filter functionality with environment variables and CLI flags
run_SetEnvVar: run SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable by name and value
run_RunAndExtractTestList: run RunAndExtractTestList to execute a test binary and parse the list of tests that were run
run_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: run InvokeWithModifiedEnv to execute a function with temporary extra environment variables that are restored after
run_RunWithSharding: run RunWithSharding to execute a test shard by index and verify the partitioned tests run correctly
